title: Fasting before anesthesia: what is allowed and when
also: when to stop eating before surgery
what: Before anesthesia, the stomach must be empty. This is safer: during sleep, stomach contents cannot get into the lungs.
why: Before any surgery or procedure under anesthesia or sedation.
duration: usually no food for about 6 hours and no water for about 2 hours, and the clinic will tell you the exact times
tell_doctor: If you have diabetes, how to handle food and medicines
If you take medicines in the morning
If you often have heartburn or reflux

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually the last meal is about 6 hours before anesthesia. Fatty and meaty food earlier still. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Water
prepare.text: Clear still water is often allowed until about 2 hours before. Milk, juice with pulp, and coffee with milk count as food.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Your doctor will say which pills to take in the morning with a sip of water.

prepare.title: Other
prepare.text: In the morning, do not chew gum or smoke. Do not drink alcohol the day before.

bring: The time of your last food and water, as the clinic told you
steps: The clinic gives the exact time of your last food and water
In the evening, have a light dinner
After the set time, you eat no more food
You drink clear water until the time that was allowed
In the morning, take only the medicines your doctor allowed
At the clinic, you will be asked when you last ate and drank, so answer honestly
feel: You may feel hungry and thirsty, which is normal
Sometimes slight dizziness or a headache from hunger
after: If you ate or drank by accident, tell the doctor right away
The surgery may be postponed, which is for your safety
After surgery, you start eating and drinking when your doctor allows

faq.q: Can I brush my teeth in the morning before surgery?
faq.a: Yes. Just do not swallow the water.
Under anesthesia, protective reflexes weaken. Food from the stomach can get into the lungs, which is dangerous.

faq.q: What if the surgery was postponed by a day?
faq.a: Ask on the ward. Usually you are allowed to eat, and fasting starts again.

reminders.text: Anesthesia tomorrow. Food and water only until the time the clinic gave. Take your morning medicines as your doctor allowed.
